name: strategy
content:
STRATEGY: Consistency-First Copy Trading

Goal: Identify traders who are positive PnL in EVERY recent month (not magnitude-selected), then place small ($5-20) taker copies on their new positions via RTDS WebSocket.

CORE FINDING (from skilled_traders/01g): Consistency-first selection (all 4 training months positive) identifies 176 traders with 65.3% holdout hit rate (z=7.46 vs 37.6% baseline). This is fundamentally different from z-score selection (Jaccard=0.031 overlap). The 4th positive month is the critical discriminator: 4-of-4 traders show +3.16% PnL/dollar in holdout vs -1.54% for 3-of-4.

MUST: Use price-aware fee model — fee = fee_rate * min(price, 1-price) * size. Flat 100bps is wrong (varies 50x by price).
MUST: Validate across multiple rolling windows (not just single Dec-Jan holdout).
MUST: Use taker-only PnL for selection (maker spread-capture confounds the signal).
MUST: Equal-weight allocation across traders ($5-10 each). Forward rank correlation is insignificant — you cannot size by conviction.
MUST: Use `trades_raw FINAL`, never the `trades` view.
MUST: Monthly recomputation of consistent trader set.
PREFER: Filter to pure takers (MVF < 0.10) to isolate directional skill.
PREFER: Exclude traders with per-market HHI > 0.3 (single-lucky-bet traders).
PREFER: Minimum 20 resolved markets per trader for statistical significance.
WARN: fee_usd is zero before 2026-01-07 — must estimate fees retroactively.
WARN: Median trader does $138/day — copies must be much smaller to stay hidden.
WARN: 96.6% holdout participation rate partly reflects activity selection bias.
